q: to his nation instructing him, “Warn your people
before a painful punishment afflicts them.”
v.s: Indeed, We sent Noah to his people, [saying], "Warn your people before there comes to them a painful punishment."
v.c: Indeed, We sent Noah to his people ˹saying to him˺, “Warn your people before a painful punishment comes to them.”

q: said, “O my people! Indeed I am a clear
v.s: He said, "O my people, indeed I am to you a clear warner -
v.c: Noah proclaimed, “O my people! I am truly sent to you with a clear warning:

q: “Worship Allaah, fear Him and obey me
v.s: [Saying], ‘Worship God, fear Him and obey me.
v.c: worship Allah ˹alone˺, fear Him, and obey me.

q: “Allaah will then forgive your sins and grant you respite
(will not punish you and will allow you to live) until a specified period (the time when your death is destined).
Verily, when Allaah's specified period (the time of your death) arrives, it is not delayed. If only you knew
(the truth of this, you would accept immediately).'
v.s: He [i.e., God] will forgive you of your sins and delay you for a specified term. Indeed, the time [set by] God, when it comes, will not be delayed, if you only knew."
v.c: He will forgive your sins, and delay your end until the appointed time. Indeed, when the time set by Allah comes, it cannot be delayed, if only you knew!”

q: (However, besides a few people, the rest of his nation rejected his message despite his tireless efforts. When he grew frustrated after 950 years of preaching to them,)
He said, “O my Rabb! Indeed I called my people
v.s: He said, "My Lord, indeed I invited my people [to truth] night and day.
v.c: He cried, “My Lord! I have surely called my people day and night,

q: “However, my calling only made them run further away.'
v.s: But my invitation increased them not except in flight [i.e., aversion].
v.c: but my calls only made them run farther away.

q: “Whenever I called them so that You may forgive them, they
(rejected my message to such an extent that they actually)
placed their fingers in their ears
v.s: And indeed, every time I invited them that You may forgive them, they put their fingers in their ears, covered themselves with their garments, persisted, and were arrogant with [great] arrogance.
v.c: And whenever I invite them to be forgiven by You, they press their fingers into their ears, cover themselves with their clothes, persist ˹in denial˺, and act very arrogantly.

v.s: Then I invited them publicly.
v.c: Then I certainly called them openly,

v.s: Then I announced to them and [also] confided to them secretly
v.c: then I surely preached to them publicly and privately,

q: “I said to them, 'Seek forgiveness from your Rabb
v.s: And said, 'Ask forgiveness of your Lord. Indeed, He is ever a Perpetual Forgiver.
v.c: saying, ‘Seek your Lord’s forgiveness, ˹for˺ He is truly Most Forgiving.

v.s: He will send [rain from] the sky upon you in [continuing] showers
v.c: He will shower you with abundant rain,

q: “'...increase your wealth, your sons and make orchards and rivers for you.
(He will cause you to prosper even in this world.)'”
v.s: And give you increase in wealth and children and provide for you gardens and provide for you rivers.
v.c: supply you with wealth and children, and give you gardens as well as rivers.

q: ‘“What is the matter with you that you are not convinced of Allaah's majesty
v.s: What is [the matter] with you that you do not attribute to God [due] grandeur
v.c: What is the matter with you that you are not in awe of the Majesty of Allah,

q: ‘“...when He has created you in so many phases?”'
(He created the food from which blood is formed, then the semen from the blood, then the foetus from the semen, then the many stages of foetal development) before the birth of a child.)
v.s: While He has created you in stages?
v.c: when He truly created you in stages ˹of development˺?

q: ‘“Have you not seen how Allaah has created the seven skies in layers...“'
v.s: Do you not consider how God has created seven heavens in layers
v.c: Do you not see how Allah created seven heavens, one above the other,

q: ‘“...has made the moon a celestial light in them
v.s: And made the moon therein a [reflected] light and made the sun a burning lamp?
v.c: placing the moon within them as a ˹reflected˺ light, and the sun as a ˹radiant˺ lamp?

q: from the earth in a unique manner.“'
v.s: And God has caused you to grow from the earth a [progressive] growth.
v.c: Allah ˹alone˺ caused you to grow from the earth like a plant.

q: ‘“He will then return you to the earth and then remove you from it in a unique manner
(when you are resurrected on the) Day of Qiyaamah).
v.s: Then He will return you into it and extract you [another] extraction.
v.c: Then He will return you to it, and then simply bring you forth ˹again˺.

q: ‘“And Allaah has spent out the earth for you...“'
v.s: And God has made for you the earth an expanse
v.c: And Allah ˹alone˺ spread out the earth for you

q: “'...so that you may travel on its wide roads.“'
(Allaah has created all these bounties for man so that he recognises Allaah through them and expresses gratitude for them by worshipping only Him Alone.)
v.s: That you may follow therein roads of passage.'"
v.c: to walk along its spacious pathways.’”

q: Nooh ﵊ said, “O my Rabb! They have refused to obey me and have followed people whose wealth and children have only increased their loss
(by causing them to fall deeper into kufr and sin by not listening to my guidance became their pride and arrogance)
v.s: Noah said, "My Lord, indeed they have disobeyed me and followed him whose wealth and children will not increase him except in loss.
v.c: ˹Eventually,˺ Noah cried, “My Lord! They have certainly persisted in disobeying me, and followed ˹instead˺ those ˹elite˺ whose ˹abundant˺ wealth and children only increase them in loss,

q: (to oppose the true Deen by not listening to my guidance).'
v.s: And they conspired an immense conspiracy
v.c: and who have devised a tremendous plot,

q: 'Never forsake your gods! Do not forsake Wadd, Suwa, Yaghooth, Ya'ooq and Nasr!”'
v.s: And said, 'Never leave your gods and never leave Wadd or Suwāʿ or Yaghūth and Yaʿūq and Nasr.'
v.c: urging ˹their followers˺, ‘Do not abandon your idols— especially Wadd, Suwâ’, Yaghûth, Ya’ûq, and Nasr.’

q: (so that they become deserving of more punishment).”
v.s: And already they have misled many. And, [my Lord], do not increase the wrongdoers except in error."
v.c: Those ˹elite˺ have already led many astray. So ˹O Lord˺, only allow the wrongdoers to stray farther away.”

q: Because of their sins they were drowned
and made to enter the Fire
(in their graves as well as in the Aakhirah). (Although they had many gods, great wealth and many children,)
They found none to assist them against
v.s: Because of their sins they were drowned and put into the Fire, and they found not for themselves besides God [any] helpers.
v.c: So because of their sins, they were drowned, then admitted into the Fire. And they found none to help them against Allah.

q: Nooh ﵊ said, “O my Rabb! Do not leave even one of the Kaafiroon
v.s: And Noah said, "My Lord, do not leave upon the earth from among the disbelievers an inhabitant.
v.c: Noah had prayed, “My Lord! Do not leave a single disbeliever on earth.

q: bondsmen and only sinners and Kuffaar will be born to them
(thereby causing more kufr and sin to reign on earth).”
v.s: Indeed, if You leave them, they will mislead Your servants and not beget except [every] wicked one and [confirmed] disbeliever.
v.c: For if You spare ˹any of˺ them, they will certainly mislead Your servants, and give birth only to ˹wicked˺ sinners, staunch disbelievers.

q: “O my Rabb! Forgive me, my parents, whoever enters my home as a Mu'min and all the Mu'mineen and Mu'minaat.
(As for the Kuffaar, I pray that you)
(Do not let any of them survive.)

Surah Nooh quoted graphically the experience of Nooh that Allaah is the Only fountain head of all blessings. Surah Jinn now presents similar proofs from the statements of the Mu'mineen Jinn to prove this belief. People are informed in this Surah that even the Jinn listen to the Qur'aan and preach Towheed to their species.
v.s: My Lord, forgive me and my parents and whoever enters my house a believer and the believing men and believing women. And do not increase the wrongdoers except in destruction."
v.c: My Lord! Forgive me, my parents, and whoever enters my house in faith, and ˹all˺ believing men and women. And increase the wrongdoers only in destruction.”
